title: Bowl of noodles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='broth' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE0A3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8B84B'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowlGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4FC3F7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0277BD'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowlBottom' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#0288D1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#01579B'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Bowl body - lower part -->
  <path d='M18 48 Q18 82 50 84 Q82 82 82 48 Z' fill='url(#bowlGrad)'/>

  <!-- Bowl rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='33' ry='10' fill='#81D4FA'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='30' ry='8' fill='url(#broth)'/>

  <!-- Broth surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='27' ry='6.5' fill='#FFE082'/>

  <!-- Noodles - wavy strands -->
  <path d='M30 45 Q34 38 40 44 Q46 50 52 43 Q58 36 64 44 Q70 50 72 44' 
        stroke='#FFF9C4' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 49 Q34 43 41 48 Q48 53 55 47 Q62 41 68 48' 
        stroke='#FFEE58' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M33 42 Q38 36 44 41 Q50 46 57 40 Q63 34 69 41' 
        stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='2.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 51 Q42 45 48 50 Q54 55 60 49 Q66 43 71 49' 
        stroke='#FFF9C4' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Egg half -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='41' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FFB300'/>

  <!-- Green onion slices -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='48' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#81C784'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='43' rx='1.8' ry='1' fill='#A5D6A7'/>

  <!-- Nori (seaweed) sheet -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q68 35 70 40 L68 46 Q64 44 62 46 Z' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <path d='M63 39 Q67 37 68 41' stroke='#43A047' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Bowl rim top edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='30' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#81D4FA' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Bowl foot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='16' ry='4' fill='url(#bowlBottom)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='14' ry='3' fill='#0288D1'/>
</svg>
